# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in svelte-excalidraw.

## Repository mirror

This repo is **mirrored from GitLab**. CI (build, publish, Docker) runs on GitLab. You can:

- **Open issues here on GitHub** — we use them for bugs and feature ideas.
- **Open pull requests here** — we’ll review and can merge on GitHub or backport to GitLab.
- Or contribute via our GitLab project if you have access.

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tips-services/svelte-excalidraw.git
cd svelte-excalidraw
npm install
npm run dev:lib    # library (packages/svelte-excalidraw)
npm run dev:docs   # docs app
npm run dev:svex   # demo app
```

- **Library:** `packages/svelte-excalidraw`
- **Docs:** `apps/docs`
- **Demo app:** `apps/svex`

## Code and issues

- Keep changes focused; prefer smaller PRs.
- For bugs, use the [Bug report](https://github.com/tips-services/svelte-excalidraw/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) template.
- For ideas, use the [Feature request](https://github.com/tips-services/svelte-excalidraw/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) template.
